option.name: --alloc
tip: Determines the allocation policy when a command needs to allocate Physical Extents (PEs) from the VG.

option.name: --background
tip: If the operation requires polling, this option causes the command to return before the operation is complete, and polling is done in the background.

option.name: --cache
tip: Specifies the command is handling a cache LV or cache pool.

option.name: --cachedevice
tip: The name of a device to use for a cache.

option.name: --cachemetadataformat
tip: Specifies the cache metadata format used by cache target.

option.name: --cachemode
tip: Specifies when writes to a cache LV should be considered complete.

option.name: --cachepolicy
tip: Specifies the cache policy for a cache LV.

option.name: --cachepool
tip: The name of a cache pool.

option.name: --cachesettings
tip: Specifies tunable kernel options for dm-cache or dm-writecache LVs.

option.name: --cachesize
tip: The size of cache to use.

option.name: --cachevol
tip: The name of a cache volume.

option.name: --chunksize
tip: The size of chunks in a snapshot, cache pool or thin pool.

option.name: --commandprofile
tip: The command profile to use for command configuration.

option.name: --compression
tip: Controls whether compression is enabled or disable for VDO volume.

option.name: --config
tip: Config settings for the command.

option.name: --debug
tip: Set debug level.

option.name: --deduplication
tip: Controls whether deduplication is enabled or disable for VDO volume.

option.name: --devices
tip: Restricts the devices that are visible and accessible to the command.

option.name: --devicesfile
tip: A file listing devices that LVM should use.

option.name: --discards
tip: Specifies how the device-mapper thin pool layer in the kernel should handle discards.

option.name: --driverloaded
tip: If set to no, the command will not attempt to use device-mapper.

option.name: --errorwhenfull
tip: Specifies thin pool behavior when data space is exhausted.

option.name: --force
tip: Override various checks, confirmations and protections.

option.name: --help
tip: Display help text.

option.name: --integritysettings
tip: Specifies tunable kernel options for dm-integrity.

option.name: --interval
tip: Report progress at regular intervals.

option.name: --journal
tip: Record information in the systemd journal.

option.name: --lockopt
tip: Used to pass options for special cases to lvmlockd.

option.name: --longhelp
tip: Display long help text.

option.name: --merge
tip: An alias for --mergethin, --mergemirrors, or --mergesnapshot, depending on the type of LV.

option.name: --mergemirrors
tip: Merge LV images that were split from a raid1 LV.

option.name: --mergesnapshot
tip: Merge COW snapshot LV into its origin.

option.name: --mergethin
tip: Merge thin LV into its origin LV.

option.name: --metadataprofile
tip: The metadata profile to use for command configuration.

option.name: --mirrorlog
tip: Specifies the type of mirror log for LVs with the "mirror" type (does not apply to the "raid1" type.) disk is a persistent log and requires a small amount of storage space, usually on a separate device from the data being mirrored.

option.name: --mirrors
tip: Specifies the number of mirror images in addition to the original LV image, e.g. --mirrors 1 means there are two images of the data, the original and one mirror image.

option.name: --name
tip: Specifies the name of a new LV.

option.name: --nohints
tip: Do not use the hints file to locate devices for PVs.

option.name: --nolocking
tip: Disable locking.

option.name: --noudevsync
tip: Disables udev synchronization.

option.name: --originname
tip: Specifies the name to use for the external origin LV when converting an LV to a thin LV.

option.name: --pooldatavdo
tip: Use VDO type volume for pool data volume.

option.name: --poolmetadata
tip: The name of a an LV to use for storing pool metadata.

option.name: --poolmetadatasize
tip: Specifies the size of the new pool metadata LV.

option.name: --poolmetadataspare
tip: Enable or disable the automatic creation and management of a spare pool metadata LV in the VG.

option.name: --profile
tip: An alias for --commandprofile or --metadataprofile, depending on the command.

option.name: --quiet
tip: Suppress output and log messages.

option.name: --raidintegrity
tip: Enable or disable data integrity checksums for raid images.

option.name: --raidintegrityblocksize
tip: The block size to use for dm-integrity on raid images.

option.name: --raidintegritymode
tip: Use a journal (default) or bitmap for keeping integrity checksums consistent in case of a crash.

option.name: --readahead
tip: Sets read ahead sector count of an LV.

option.name: --regionsize
tip: Size of each raid or mirror synchronization region.

option.name: --repair
tip: Replace failed PVs in a raid or mirror LV, or run a repair utility on a thin pool.

option.name: --replace
tip: Replace a specific PV in a raid LV with another PV.

option.name: --setactivationskip
tip: Persistently sets (yes) or clears (no) the "activation skip" flag on an LV.

option.name: --snapshot
tip: Combine a former COW snapshot LV with a former origin LV to reverse a previous --splitsnapshot command.

option.name: --splitcache
tip: Separates a cache pool from a cache LV, and keeps the unused cache pool LV.

option.name: --splitmirrors
tip: Splits the specified number of images from a raid1 or mirror LV and uses them to create a new LV.

option.name: --splitsnapshot
tip: Separates a COW snapshot from its origin LV.

option.name: --startpoll
tip: Start polling an LV to continue processing a conversion.

option.name: --stripes
tip: Specifies the number of stripes in a striped LV.

option.name: --stripesize
tip: The amount of data that is written to one device before moving to the next in a striped LV.

option.name: --swapmetadata
tip: Extracts the metadata LV from a pool and replaces it with another specified LV.

option.name: --test
tip: Run in test mode.

option.name: --thin
tip: Specifies the command is handling a thin LV or thin pool.

option.name: --thinpool
tip: The name of a thin pool LV.

option.name: --trackchanges
tip: Can be used with --splitmirrors on a raid1 LV.

option.name: --type
tip: The LV type, also known as segment type.

option.name: --uncache
tip: Separates a cache pool from a cache LV, and deletes the unused cache pool LV.

option.name: --usepolicies
tip: Perform an operation according to the policy configured in lvm.conf(5) or a profile.

option.name: --vdopool
tip: The name of a VDO pool LV.

option.name: --vdosettings
tip: Specifies tunable VDO options for VDO LVs.

option.name: --verbose
tip: Set verbose level.

option.name: --version
tip: Display version information.

option.name: --virtualsize
tip: The virtual size of a new thin LV.

option.name: --wipesignatures
tip: Controls detection and subsequent wiping of signatures on new LVs.

option.name: --yes
tip: Do not prompt for confirmation interactively but always assume the answer yes.

option.name: --zero
tip: For snapshots, this controls zeroing of the first 4 KiB of data in the snapshot.
